title: Implement new batch page — Tab B (single entry form)
description: Implement the single entry form tab on the new batch page. Allows adding one prospect at a time with a form. Includes a toggle for 'Has existing website?' that reveals the URL field.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab B renders a form with all prospect fields
'Has existing website?' toggle shows/hides the URL field
Form validates required fields (business_name) before submission
Adding a prospect adds it to a list below the form (can add multiple before submitting)
List shows all added prospects with a remove button per row
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.description: Implement Tab B form in the new batch page
steps.details: Form fields: business_name (required), industry (dropdown, inherits from batch), location, phone, email, 'Has website?' toggle, existing_url (shown only when toggle is on), notes. Use shadcn/ui Form, Input, Select, Switch components.
'Add Prospect' button validates form, appends the prospect to a list (useState array). Clears form for next entry. Shows running list below with remove (×) button per row.
Same submission logic as Tab A: POST batch + prospects. Redirect to batch detail.
Take Playwright screenshot. Toggle the website switch and verify URL field appears/disappears. Add 2 prospects and verify they appear in the list.
